## Task

You are debugging Django's URL resolution entrypoint in
django/urls/base.py and django/urls/resolvers.py. Starting from
`django.urls.base.resolve`, trace the exact causal pipeline used to
obtain the (possibly cached) resolver for the current urlconf. Assume
`resolve` is called without an explicit `urlconf` argument (the
default), so it must look up the current thread's urlconf itself
rather than skip straight to resolving the resolver.

First give a short (2-4 sentence) explanation of the pipeline.

Then, on its own line, emit a fenced JSON code block containing an
ordered array of the fully-qualified symbol names in that causal
order - only symbols actually present in the provided context package
may appear, e.g.:

```json
["django.urls.base.resolve", "django.urls.base.get_urlconf"]
```


## Response format

Respond with a single fenced JSON object and nothing else:
```json
{"reasoning": "<short explanation>", "symbols": ["<fully.qualified.name>", "..."]}
```
`symbols` lists every code symbol that is part of your answer, in order, by exact fully-qualified name.
